# Hepatitis: a normal hierarchical model with measurement error (with measurement error)
# Generated from JuliaBUGS.BUGSExamples.VOLUME_3.hepatitis_me
using JuliaBUGS

model_def = JuliaBUGS.@bugs("""
model
{
    tau.alpha ~ dgamma(0.001, 0.001)
    alpha0 ~ dnorm(0.0, 1.0E-6)
    beta0 ~ dnorm(0.0, 1.0E-6)
    tau.beta ~ dgamma(0.001, 0.001)
    for(i in 1:N) {
        alpha[i] ~ dnorm(alpha0, tau.alpha)
        beta[i] ~ dnorm(beta0, tau.beta)
        y0[i] ~ dnorm(mu0[i], tau)
        mu0[i] ~ dnorm(theta, psi)
    }
    for(j in 1:T) {
        for(i in 1:N) {
            Y[i, j] ~ dnorm(mu[i, j], tau)
            mu[i, j] <- alpha[i] + beta[i] * (t[i, j] - 6.5) + 
                gamma * (mu0[i] - mean(y0[]))
        }
    }
    tau ~ dgamma(0.001, 0.001)
    sigma <- 1 / sqrt(tau)
    gamma ~ dnorm(0.0, 1.0E-6)
    theta ~ dnorm(0.0, 1.0E-6)
    psi ~ dgamma(0.001, 0.001)
}
""", false)

build_model(data, inits = (;)) = JuliaBUGS.compile(model_def, data, inits)
